items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Private Safety Processing to strengthen multi-turn safety while preserving Zero Data Retention
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI預覽Private Safety Processing，在維持零數據保留下強化多輪安全
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it will continue offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models and is previewing Private Safety Processing. The system identifies risk patterns across related interactions via automated signals without giving OpenAI personnel access to underlying customer content. Rollout and a technical white paper are planned for September.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布將持續為前沿模型提供零數據保留（ZDR），並預覽Private Safety Processing。該系統透過自動化訊號跨相關互動辨識風險模式，且不讓OpenAI人員接觸底層客戶內容。預計9月擴大推出並發布技術白皮書。
items_flat.analysis_en: This directly addresses enterprise privacy concerns amid rising agentic and multi-turn risks, positioning OpenAI against competitors that require longer data retention for safety. Effectiveness will hinge on signal quality and customer willingness to share context when flagged.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這直接回應企業在代理與多輪風險上升下的隱私顧慮，並與要求較長數據保留的競爭對手形成差異。成效將取決於訊號品質，以及被標記時客戶是否願意分享脈絡。
items_flat.quote: We will continue to offer Zero Data Retention for frontier models. ... we're previewing Private Safety Processing, which is designed to improve safety without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying content.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們將持續為前沿模型提供零數據保留。……我們正在預覽Private Safety Processing，旨在提升安全卻不讓OpenAI人員接觸底層內容。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens with learning focus and default safety protections
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT青少年版，聚焦學習並強化預設安全防護
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT for Teens, an experience that automatically activates for users estimated or stating ages 13-17. It prioritizes Study Mode, responsible homework reminders, quizzes, and parental controls while applying stricter default safeguards.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布推出ChatGPT青少年版，會自動啟用於預估或自報年齡13-17歲的用戶。產品優先Study Mode、負責任作業提醒、測驗與家長控制，並套用更嚴格的預設防護。
items_flat.analysis_en: This formalizes age-tiered product design under regulatory and public pressure. Effectiveness will depend on age-prediction accuracy and whether Study Mode meaningfully reduces short-form entertainment use among teens.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉在監管與公眾壓力下正式化分齡產品設計。成效取決於年齡預測準確度，以及Study Mode是否能實質減少青少年短影音娛樂式使用。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing ChatGPT for Teens, an experience designed to help teens learn, think critically, deepen understanding, and use AI with confidence.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 ChatGPT for Teens，這是一個專為幫助青少年學習、批判思考、深化理解，並有信心使用 AI 而設計的體驗。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI paces frontier development after cyber-capability thresholds and Hugging Face incident
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI在網路能力門檻與Hugging Face事件後調整前沿開發節奏
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published that it temporarily slowed reinforcement-learning training and is expanding monitoring, alignment, and security after the Hugging Face incident and preliminary evidence that its upcoming Astra model may meet Critical cybersecurity capability thresholds under its Preparedness Framework.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI公開表示，在Hugging Face事件及初步證據顯示即將推出的Astra模型可能達到Preparedness Framework「關鍵」網路安全能力門檻後，已暫時放緩強化學習訓練，並擴大監控、對齊與安全措施。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post signals that cyber capability growth is now directly constraining training cadence at a frontier lab. Key uncertainty remains how long the pause lasts and whether peer labs adopt similar self-imposed brakes.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文顯示網路能力成長已直接約束前沿實驗室的訓練節奏。關鍵不確定性在於暫停會持續多久，以及同儕實驗室是否採取類似自我設限。
items_flat.quote: We wanted to take the time necessary to meet those standards, so we temporarily slowed the pace of scaling.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們希望花必要時間達到那些標準，因此暫時放緩了擴展節奏。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced that Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock. The model offers a 500k context window and configurable reasoning levels, targeted at long-running agents and interactive work, with listed pricing of $2/$6 per million tokens (Global CRIS).
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI宣布Grok 4.6已於Amazon Bedrock全面可用。該模型具備50萬token上下文視窗與可配置推理等級，鎖定長時運行代理與互動工作，定價為每百萬token輸入2美元、輸出6美元（Global CRIS）。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bedrock availability expands enterprise distribution for Grok beyond direct API and GitHub Copilot, lowering friction for AWS-centric teams. Uptake will depend on real-world agent performance and cost relative to other frontier options on the platform.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Bedrock上架擴大Grok在企業端的通路，超越直接API與GitHub Copilot，降低AWS生態團隊採用門檻。實際採用將取決於代理實務表現及相對平台上其他前沿模型的成本。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re excited to announce that Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock. Grok 4.6 is our latest flagship model, built for long-running agents and ambitious interactive and visual work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們很高興宣布Grok 4.6已於Amazon Bedrock全面可用。Grok 4.6是我們最新旗艦模型，專為長時運行代理與高企圖心的互動與視覺工作打造。
